instrument.name: Berg Balance Scale
instrument.purpose: clinician-rated static and dynamic functional balance
instrument.missing_item_policy: Rawafid does not calculate a final total until all 14 items have a numeric score.

rmd.cde_notice: RMD/NINDS CDE states the Berg Balance Scale is available in the public domain.
rmd.interpretation_warning: RMD states there is no common interpretation of BBS scores; population-specific cutoffs differ.

rights.rawafid_page_status: independent operational Arabic rendering of the public-domain instrument

arabic_evidence.citation: The activities-specific balance confidence scale and berg balance scale: Reliability and validity in Arabic-speaking vestibular patients.
arabic_evidence.finding: Arabic BBS total score showed high inter-rater and intra-rater agreement and significant expected correlations with Arabic ABC and Arabic DHI.
